acceptanceCriteria: GitHub Actions acceptance_replay dispatch on merged develop succeeds without Cargo.lock and reaches isolated replay receipt.
Workflow does not require or generate a repository Cargo.lock as a tracked canonical artifact.

Receipt preserves lexical_regression.warsh=PASS, lexical_regression.real_geopolitical=PASS, canonical_state_unchanged=true, publishable=false, decision_weight=0, and notification.source=generated_report_payload when notify=true.
No production Decision/Gate/Execution/Trader/Position Sizing or replay computation semantics change.
goal: 移除仅针对不存在 Cargo.lock 的 --locked 约束，保持 acceptance-replay 的 immutable input、isolated output、publishable=false、观察-only 与通知 provenance 不变。
intent: 修复 acceptance-replay workflow 的仓库构建入口，使已合并的隔离回放能够在不提交 Cargo.lock 的 Sentinel 仓库中实际运行并完成验收发送。
outOfScope: Acceptance replay Rust computation semantics；canonical snapshot/data/freshness；Decision/Gate/Action Matrix/Execution/Trader/Position Sizing；provider/secret/config credential；Cargo.lock introduction；unrelated coverage threshold or modules；daily report generate/resend semantics。

scenarioCoverage.expected: The merged develop workflow starts cargo without requiring a tracked Cargo.lock and produces an isolated acceptance-replay receipt.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: Workflow dispatch reaches isolated replay without Cargo.lock
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Dispatch .github/workflows/acceptance_replay.yml on the merged develop SHA and inspect the completed run and artifact receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Only the cargo invocation changes; replay lexical, isolation, provenance, notification, and decision assertions remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: Workflow-only repair preserves replay and decision boundaries
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused acceptance-replay tests and compare the workflow diff against the Contract out-of-scope boundary.

scope: .github/workflows/acceptance_replay.yml 仅调整 cargo invocation；tests/acceptance_replay.rs 仅在需要时补充 workflow contract regression；AI Cockpit governance evidence。
